personas.name: Maya
personas.description: A second-year history-of-art student. She reads Wikipedia constantly and cites it never — her use of the site is to find out **whose** work to read next. Fast, sceptical, and more interested in the reference list than the article.

personas.name: Tom
personas.description: A long-time volunteer editor who watches a handful of articles. He spends most of his time in the surfaces readers never open — revision histories, diffs, and talk pages — deciding whether a change was an improvement.
